Connect your Facebook Page

Connect your Facebook Page (and the Instagram account linked to it) so our AI assistant can reply to your customers' Messenger and Instagram messages.

What happens

  1. Facebook's own login opens when you press the button below. We never see your password.
  2. Choose the Page you want to connect, and approve the permissions.
  3. After that, when a customer messages your Page, the assistant answers from the product information you give us; hard questions are handed to you, and your team can take over the chat from our dashboard.

We never message anyone who has not written to your Page first, and we send no promotional or bulk messages. You can remove the permissions at any time in Facebook Settings → Business Integrations. Details: Privacy Policy · Terms

You will continue on Facebook
